issues.concern: The English translation 'emotional photo' is unnatural and misrepresents the nuance of 'エモい' in this context. 'エモい' here implies a photo that evokes strong feelings, often nostalgic or sentimental, rather than the photo itself being emotional.
issues.suggestion: I took a moving photo of the sunset. / I took a photo of the sunset that really hit me. / I took a really evocative photo of the sunset.
